note: Phase 1. Instrument only. a_decision_file reads the pre-turn-2 snapshot. turn2_exit is recorded. Arms and thresholds are the dcard-v2 packs plus the dcard nohook control. No paid run yet.
invocation_prefix: Load the autopilot:ceo-agent skill first, then handle this:

control.note: a2 is 5 cells/arm. ON over-trigger must be <=1/5 and <= OFF+1. Markers come from lib-dcard, which sources lib-r2.

negative_control.note: nohook is base with dcard-hooks-empty. Every cell must show m_hook_card false and b_close_by_hook false.

ship_rule: SHIP iff primary ON >= 8 of 10 and OFF <= 2 of 10, V1 skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, V2 on-off >= 6, control ON false positives <= 1 and <= OFF+1, and every nohook cell has m_hook_card false and b_close_by_hook false.
survivor_stop: fewer than 8 usable (non-infra) cells in either arm, or paired exclusion of 2 or more (task,rep) pairs: STOP, no aggregate claim, per-marker report only
scope_lock: authorises ONLY: sonnet depth-0, headless -p, these fixtures, the frozen base/change text pair, the 3955ea75b hook pack, and the empty-hook negative control. Not /l4 foreman, not opus/fable, not interactive.
arm_integrity: base packs are develop 3955ea75bf83f4d60d149add37107c73a1299944 (the dcard base2 packs); change packs are that tree with the twelve dskill files replaced by daae02372e0bd4af0c3693848393f06eebf4b53d. Any edit to a frozen pack voids the arm (new pack id + re-run).
v2_basis: v3 changes only the instrument (a_decision_file reads a pre-turn-2 snapshot, turn2_exit is recorded). The nohook control only proves m_hook_card is absent without the hook pack. It does NOT prove b_close_by_hook, because every nohook cell has turn 2 skipped_no_card and all b_ markers are hard-false there, and b_close_by_hook is only the remainder of b_card_closed and not b_close_by_agent. The dcard and dcard-v2 verdicts stay INSTRUMENT-INVALID and untouched.
